y-m-15-07.topic: Karanta jadawalin sanduna: inda ma'aunin tsaye yake farawa da kuma tasirin tsawon sanda
y-m-15-07.goal: Sanin cewa tsawon sanduna na bayanai iri ɗaya yana kama daban bisa ƙimar farawar ma'aunin tsaye, nemo ka gyara karatu mai jawo rashin fahimta, sannan ka rubuta take da ke sanarwa ba tare da ruɗani ba.
y-m-15-07.material:
Matsakaicin gwajin raka'a na Aji na 1 a aji na 5 maki 82 ne, na Aji na 2 kuma 85. Ka zana bayanai iri ɗaya a jadawalin sanduna biyu ga jaridar aji. Sanduna duk suna tashi daga ƙasa zuwa sama.
- Jadawali ㉮: ma'aunin tsaye yana farawa da maki 0 har 100, kowane tazara maki 10.
- Jadawali ㉯: ma'aunin tsaye yana farawa da maki 80 zuwa 90, kowane tazara maki 1. Ba a zana ɓangaren ƙasa da 80 ba, sanduna suna nuna ɓangaren da ya tashi sama da 80 kawai.

Doun ya kalli jadawali ㉯ ya yi bayani kamar haka.
